- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Digital cameras revolutionized the industry by allowing easier editing and immediate feedback on footage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The addition of sound in films in the late 1920s opened up new storytelling possibilities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Developments in sound technology include stereo sound and Dolby Digital.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Special effects techniques have evolved from practical effects to CGI, allowing for more realistic and immersive worlds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of special effects include stop-motion animation in "King Kong" (1933) and CGI in "Avatar" (2009).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Film editing has evolved from physically cutting and splicing film to using digital editing software like Avid and Final Cut Pro.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The rise of streaming services like Netflix and Amazon Prime has changed film distribution and consumption.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Digital platforms like YouTube and Vimeo have made it easier for independent filmmakers to share their content.
